summary: Diff shows significant progress: backend state is restructured to be per-user (Principal -> UserData with categories keyed by Text), authorization checks are added broadly, and frontend now routes category CRUD through backend sync APIs with case-insensitive duplicate checks in some UI flows. However, key acceptance criteria around category rename/delete semantics, stable upgrade persistence, and auto-loading/error-state behavior on login are not verifiably implemented from the provided truncated diffs.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fix backend category CRUD semantics so that renaming updates stored category entry and updates every prompt that references the old category name; deleting detaches from all prompts and removes the category; no stale entries after rename/delete.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo is truncated before any category CRUD implementations (e.g., getAllCategories/saveCategory/updateCategoryName/deleteCategory) and before any prompt-update loops that would rename/detach category names within existing prompts. The frontend API expects actor methods (updateCategoryName/deleteCategory), but their backend behavior is not evidenced.
evidence: backend/main.mo (truncated; only shows types, user data helpers, and prompt CRUD beginnings)

missing_requirements.requirement: Persist backend state across canister upgrades for per-user prompts and categories; run conditional migration if needed without corrupting data.
missing_requirements.reason: A migration module is added and backend/main.mo references a migration runner, but the diff does not show any stable variable declarations or preupgrade/postupgrade (or equivalent) logic wiring stable persistence and applying migration conditionally. Therefore upgrade persistence cannot be confirmed from the summary.
evidence: backend/main.mo (shows '(with migration = Migration.run)' but no stable persistence hooks are visible in the truncated excerpt)

missing_requirements.requirement: On successful login, automatically load categories from the backend and render them immediately below Favorites; show an error state (not empty list) when backend connectivity fails.
missing_requirements.reason: frontend/src/App.tsx is truncated before any login effect/handler logic that would call refreshFromBackend (or category fetch) after login, and before wiring of backend connectivity error into category UI. CategoryFilterBar accepts backendReady/backendError/backendStatusMessage props, but the diff summary does not show App passing these props or triggering category load on login.
evidence: frontend/src/App.tsx (truncated; shows usePromptLibrarySync destructuring refreshFromBackend etc. but not the login-success effect)
frontend/src/components/categories/CategoryFilterBar.tsx (has backendReady/backendError/backendStatusMessage props, but parent wiring not shown)
